title: Connection Pool Management
outcome: Implement connection pool in SessionManager: 4 concurrent max, priority queuing, 30s cleanup, statistics tracking.
rationale: Prevents browser connection pool exhaustion. Browsers limit 6-10 connections. Conservative limit (4) with priority queuing ensures critical requests (session checks) not stalled.

risk.acceptance: Adds latency for queued requests but prevents stalls. Conservative limit (4) might increase after production testing.

technical_debt.resolution: Monitor and increase after production testing
